youtube.comment: Optional. Requires a YouTube Data API v3 key in the YOUTUBE_API_KEY env var. YouTube is now one source among five - leave search_terms empty to drop video entirely.

papers.comment: Research papers from Hugging Face Papers (https://huggingface.co/papers). Public API, no key or account needed. 'queries' are full-text searches; 'include_daily' also sweeps the Daily Papers feed and keeps anything that matches a topic.
queries: tool use function calling LLM agent

hackernews.comment: Latest blogs and articles surfaced on Hacker News, via the public Algolia API (no key). 'blogs_only' keeps stories that link out to an article and drops Ask/Tell HN text posts. Sorted newest-first at the source.

podcasts.comment: Podcast RSS feeds. Every episode is pulled; items are kept only if the title/description matches a topic, unless keep_all is true for that feed.

feeds.name: Latent Space: The AI Engineer Podcast

websites.comment: Blogs and docs to scrape links from. Provide a URL and a CSS-ish hint for the links to extract (the scraper reads all <a> tags and keeps the ones whose text matches a topic).

match.comment: An item is tagged with a topic if any of that topic's regexes (case-insensitive) hit its title or description. Anything matching 'exclude' is dropped first - 'Hermes' is a busy word.
